author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮೂಳೆಯಿಲ್ಲದ ರಸನೆಗಂಕುಶವ ಹಾಕಿಬಿಡು
ಕೀಳು ಮಾತುಗಳಾಡೆ ನಾಶ ನಿಶ್ಚಿತವು
ಏಳುಬೀಳುಗಳಿಗೆಲ್ಲಾ ನಿನನುಡಿಯೆ ಆಧಾರ
ಬಾಳು ಹಿತ ಮಿತದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Put a goad on the boneless tongue;
if you speak low words, ruin is certain;
your words are the ground of all your rises and falls;
live with kindness and measure, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The tongue has no bone, yet it can break everything. Coarse speech brings ruin; our words decide our fortunes. Speak kindly and sparingly.
